articles.headline: Broadcom aims for 50% VMware Cloud Foundation 9 adoption as AI speeds vulnerability discovery
articles.summary: Broadcom is pushing enterprises toward faster VCF 9 upgrades, arguing that AI is accelerating vulnerability discovery and making on-premises ownership more attractive than rented infrastructure. For companies, this can affect software refresh timing, security posture, and infrastructure spending decisions.

articles.headline: GlobalFoundries and TSMC agree to U.S.-based silicon interposer supply for advanced AI packaging
articles.summary: The agreement expands U.S.-based capacity for silicon interposers used in advanced AI packaging, supporting rising demand for high-performance computing and AI systems. This is business-relevant because packaging capacity can affect AI hardware availability, supplier diversification, and lead times for infrastructure buyers.

articles.headline: SailPoint adds AI agent discovery and compliance automation for enterprise identity security
articles.summary: SailPoint’s new capabilities give organizations visibility into hidden AI tools, temporary access controls, and continuous compliance across human and machine workflows. That matters for businesses trying to reduce identity risk, limit standing privileges, and automate governance without adding headcount.
